name: Montana

default_limits.basis: MCA 61-8-303(1) (2025, HB 312): interstate 80 (65 inside urbanized areas 50k+); 4-lane national highway segments 10+ mi 75 day/70 night; other public highways 70 day/65 night; urban district 25. Values shown are daytime; subtract 5 at night on non-interstates.

fine.notes: Fixed fines, MCA 61-8-725 (2025). On interstates (61-8-303(1)(a)) 1-10 over is $40; other brackets same. Special speed zones (61-8-309/310) are excluded from this schedule.

court_costs.notes: The 3-1-317 surcharge may not be added to 61-8-303 speeding (61-8-725(3)). Other court costs not verified.

points.notes: 3 pts (MCA 61-11-203). Not recorded if <=10 over by day or <=5 over at night, unless over 90 on interstate, CDL holder, or out-of-state ticket. 30 pts in 3 yrs = habitual offender.

zones.work_zone: Fines reported as at least doubled (secondary source only; statute not read).
zones.school_zone: Fines reported as at least doubled (secondary source only; statute not read).

court.reason: Below 11 over (day) / 6 over (night) the ticket is not recorded and not treated as criminal; above that, and over 90 on interstates, it goes on the record with 3 points and fines jump.

arrest.offense: Reckless driving (misdemeanor) - no speed number; requires willful or wanton disregard for safety
arrest.license: no mandatory suspension for one conviction; 5 points

trucks.notes: Trucks/truck tractors over 1 ton rated capacity: 70 on interstates, 65 on other public highways (MCA 61-8-312). Certain permitted combinations: 65.

sources.title: MT Dept of Admin - habitual offender point schedule

notes: Limits and fines changed by HB 312 (2025). Reckless penalty (61-8-715: up to 90 days, $100-$500) and zone fines came from secondary sources; statute text not read. Passing on 2-lane roads: may exceed limit by 10 mph.
